title: Anti-iNKT MicroBeads Isolation Protocol
author: Ajit N Shah
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bacuiaww

steps.title: Centrifuge cells and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 10 min, then aspirate the supernatant completely.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet, add beads, and incubate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 µL buffer per 10⁸ total cells, add 100 µL Anti‑iNKT MicroBeads per 10⁸ cells, mix well, and incubate 15 min at 2–8 °C (refrigerator).

steps.title: Wash cells and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 1–2 mL buffer per 10⁸ cells, centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min, and aspirate the supernatant completely.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for column loading
steps.instruction: Resuspend up to 10⁸ cells in 500 µL buffer.

steps.title: Prepare magnetic column
steps.instruction: Place the column in the magnetic field of a suitable MACS Separator and rinse it with 3 mL buffer (LS column).

steps.title: Load sample onto column and collect flow-through
steps.instruction: Apply the cell suspension onto the column and collect the flow‑through containing unlabeled cells.

steps.title: Wash column and collect unlabeled cells
steps.instruction: Wash the column with buffer (3 × 3 mL for LS column), collect the unlabeled cells that pass through, and combine them with the previous effluent.

steps.title: Elute magnetically labeled iNKT cells
steps.instruction: Remove the column from the separator, place it on a collection tube, pipette the appropriate amount of buffer onto the column, then immediately flush out the magnetically labeled cells by firmly pushing the plunger (5 mL for LS column).

steps.title: Optional second column enrichment
steps.instruction: If higher purity is required, repeat the enrichment by passing the eluted fraction over a second MS or LS column.
